description: This file defines the SelectExtender class, which extends and decorates Select queries in Drupal's database API, providing methods for query manipulation and extension.

classes.name: SelectExtender
classes.description: A class that extends Select queries to add additional functionality and query extension capabilities.

methods.name: uniqueIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this query object.

methods.name: nextPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns the next placeholder index and increments the counter.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a tag to the query.

methods.name: hasTag
methods.description: Checks if the query has a specific tag.

methods.name: hasAllTags
methods.description: Checks if the query has all specified tags.

methods.name: hasAnyTag
methods.description: Checks if the query has any of the specified tags.

methods.name: condition
methods.description: Adds a condition to the query.

methods.name: conditions
methods.description: Returns the conditions of the query.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Returns the arguments of the query.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Adds a where clause snippet to the query.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the query with the given connection and placeholder.

methods.name: havingIsNull
methods.description: Adds a HAVING IS NULL condition.

methods.name: havingIsNotNull
methods.description: Adds a HAVING IS NOT NULL condition.

methods.name: havingNotExists
methods.description: Adds a HAVING NOT EXISTS condition.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends the query with a specified extender class.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the fields of the query.

methods.name: getExpressions
methods.description: Returns the expressions of the query.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns the tables involved in the query.

methods.name: escapeLike
methods.description: Escapes a string for LIKE queries.

methods.name: isPrepared
methods.description: Checks if the query is prepared.

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: Sets whether the query is DISTINCT.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a field to the SELECT clause.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Sets multiple fields for the SELECT clause.

methods.name: addExpression
methods.description: Adds an expression to the query.

methods.name: addJoin
methods.description: Adds a join of specified type.

methods.name: isNotNull
methods.description: Adds an IS NOT NULL condition.

methods.name: alwaysFalse
methods.description: Adds a condition that always evaluates to false.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the query.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles calls to undefined methods, forwarding them to the underlying query.

methods.name: conditionGroupFactory
methods.description: Creates a condition group with specified conjunction.
